Research / Drones in a digital twin

Drones in a digital twin

Simulated drones flying through a 3D copy of WPI’s campus, with their radio signals modeled as they bounce off real buildings.

Role
Student Research Assistant
Lab
TRAIN Lab, WPI ECE
Timeline
May 2026 – now
Key tools
Isaac Sim, Pegasus Sim, Sionna

The goal

A testbed for physical AI: multiple drones flying through a realistic digital twin of WPI, built with 3D Gaussian splatting.

What I’m building

A multi-drone simulation platform in Pegasus Sim and NVIDIA Isaac Sim, with custom PID flight control for each drone.

Radio modeling

Ray tracing in NVIDIA Sionna follows every path a signal can take, including line-of-sight, reflection, refraction, and diffraction, so the drones can communicate in real time inside the twin.
